caption: Lago Bianco, Poschiavo
composition: Bernina Pass beside Ospizio Bernina looking along Lago Bianco · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Lago Bianco stretches along the Bernina Pass as a milky reservoir, seen from the road beside Ospizio Bernina, with the Bernina railway on the shore and high rock peaks around the saddle. Most of the water is in the municipality of Poschiavo; the northern dam alone is in Pontresina, so the caption uses Poschiavo. At about 2234 metres in late September the ground is rock and tawny turf, with residual snow only in shaded gullies. The Open-Meteo model is this pass cell, and the town of Poschiavo itself lies far below in the valley.
